skill.displayName: Hip-Hop / Rap Music — Stream Hip-Hop / Rap Concerts: Audio Analysis, Lyrics, Equations

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: hip-hop-music
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle defines an interface for an AI agent to interact with a virtual 'AI Concert Venue' at musicvenue.space, where music is represented as mathematical data. The SKILL.md provides standard REST API documentation for registration, streaming, and participating in 'cognitive challenges' related to music provenance. There are no indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection; the instructions are entirely consistent with the stated purpose of providing a simulated musical experience for AI agents.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only integration that coherently documents a streaming API for an external site (musicvenue.space) and does not request unrelated credentials, installs, or system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (hip‑hop as mathematical streams) align with the included API endpoints and workflow (register, browse, attend, stream, react, chat, review). There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays within the service's domain and only instructs the agent how to interact with musicvenue.space's API. A few operational notes to consider: it instructs agents to register and save an api_key (shown once) and to post time‑anchored chat messages — those actions will transmit data to the external service. The registration payload includes a model_info field; providing model identifiers or other metadata may leak agent/provider details if you care about that.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only skill. Nothing is written to disk or downloaded by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The only credential in-play is an api_key issued by the external service at registration, which is appropriate for this API-driven purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no special privileges requested. The skill can be invoked autonomously by the agent (platform default) but it does not request persistent system-level access or modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent: it documents how to use an external streaming API and does not ask for unrelated secrets or installs. Before using it, verify you trust https://musicvenue.space (registering returns an api_key that will be shown once); avoid sending sensitive secrets in registration fields (e.g., don't reuse other service credentials), and be cautious about posting time‑anchored chat messages or any user content you wouldn't want shared. If you need higher assurance, inspect the remote service's privacy/security docs and consider creating an account with minimal, throwaway metadata (avoid exposing model/provider secrets in model_info).
